cues: Isocitrate loses a carbon dioxide and makes NADH, giving alpha-ketoglutarate, five carbons.
A second carbon dioxide and NADH give succinyl coenzyme A, four carbons.
text: Isocitrate loses a carbon dioxide and makes NADH, giving alpha-ketoglutarate, five carbons. A second carbon dioxide and NADH give succinyl coenzyme A, four carbons.
